note: One list for the "About this font" records, shared by the writer's self-check, tools/fonts.mjs about and the tests: words matched as whole words, case-insensitive (so "write them" is fine and "em" alone is not); phrases matched anywhere, case-insensitive; patterns are regular expressions for glyph counts, file sizes and fractions. addressHashes are SHA-256 hashes of lower-case address pieces of one or two words, so this public file never spells out a type designer's address; a text is checked by hashing each word and each pair of neighbouring words (letters and digits only).
